# TravelHub

> Multi-tenant travel platform for European and Turkish agencies offering car rentals, transfers, limo services, city tours, and apartment bookings through branded storefronts.

## Pages

- [Admin sign-in](/login): Agency and platform admin authentication.

## Optional

Each agency operates a branded storefront under `/agency/{slug}` with home, services, fleet, about, and contact routes. Routes are tenant-specific and not enumerated here.
